# Local dashboard assets

AdminLTE 4.0.0 and Bootstrap 5.3.3. Both use the MIT licence. Bootstrap bundle includes Popper; its licence notice is retained in the bundle. Compiled AdminLTE CSS includes Bootstrap styling. No separate Bootstrap CSS is required.

The URLs below document where the teacher bundle was obtained. The application itself uses only local `/static/vendor/...` paths. No student downloads from a CDN at runtime. Keep all licence files.

Official documentation: https://docs.adminlte.io/html/introduction and https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.3/getting-started/introduction/ . Use the files and markup provided here as the version-pinned classroom reference.
